summary.verdict: VALIDATED (first EXTERNAL EXPERIMENTAL validation in the program): FBA-predicted essentiality is strongly enriched for EXPERIMENTAL (PEC single-gene-knockout) essentiality — odds ratio 64.3 (Fisher p=3.1e-24), and 6/7 locked EXPVAL predictions are experimentally essential (ribA/ribB/folB/ribD/ispG/ispD confirmed; mtnN is a confirmed FALSE POSITIVE). So the mechanism signal (MET1-3, the arc's key positive) is REAL against independent experimental ground truth — not in-silico luck. **HONEST SCOPE (falsify-first on our own positive): (1) the validated quantity is the binary FBA-essential ENRICHMENT (precision 24/31=77%); RECALL is LOW (24/107=22%) — FBA is metabolic-scoped and misses 83 experimentally-essential genes (translation/non-metabolic), exactly as caveated in MET1. (2) The CONTINUOUS growth-ratio AUROC is a modest 0.63 — the binary call is what is strongly validated, not fine ranking. (3) This validates ESSENTIALITY enrichment vs experiment; it does NOT validate the drug-target, selectivity, or clinical claims (those remain separate and unvalidated). PEC is E. coli only; broad-bacterial validation still open.**
